description: Get income statement, balance sheet and cash flow data for a company (revenue, profitability, debt, cash position), in annual, quarterly or trailing-twelve-month views.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods to return (1-40). Defaults to 8.

type.description: Financial period type: "annual", "quarter", or "ttm" (trailing twelve months). Defaults to annual.

name: get_financials
title: Get Financial Statements
